component.name: Night Sky
component.summary: Tonight's real sky, and then the real sky outside

description.p: Night Sky draws the real sky over you tonight in fine dots: the stars, the Moon at its real phase, and the planets that are really up. Sweep across it and catch the night's handful of finds. Each visit slows as you play, dims for a real reason, and ends by naming something you can go outside and see.

ul.li: The sky is worked out on your computer from your time zone: no location service
A few things to find each night, and then the sky is done until it turns
Set down what's weighing on you, and watch it set in the west
A logbook kept as plain files you can read, copy or delete
No network access at all: nothing you write leaves your computer
